Our method, overall, achieves the best rendering quality and robust convergence in the majority of scenes. It is worth noting that the metrics we used are the same as those in the main text, with LPIPS using the VGG network. The slight differences in our measurement metrics, compared to those used in NeRF-DS and HyperNeRF, are due to their papers employing MS-SSIM and LPIPS with the AlexNet.

literalMemberRows.sourceContext:
Paper: Deformable 3D Gaussians for High-Fidelity Monocular Dynamic Scene Reconstruction

Section: Table 3 . Quantitative comparison on NeRF-DS dataset per-scene. We color each cell as best , second best , and third best . Our method, overall, achieves the best rendering quality and robust convergence in the majority of scenes. It is worth noting that the metrics we used are the same as those in the main text, with LPIPS using the VGG network. The slight differences in our measurement metrics, compared to those used in NeRF-DS and HyperNeRF, are due to their papers employing MS-SSIM and LPIPS with the AlexNet.
